header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Mir Muhammad Nohri advocate for the petitioner.
body: In compliance of the last order dated 16.09.2026, learned D.A.G has filed statement alongwith two original cheques bearing No.1189743856 dated 26.09.2026 of Rs.22064/- and No.1189743857 dated 26.09.2026 of Rs.50,000/-, the same are taken on record. The Additional Registrar of this Court is directed to hand over the same to the petitioner after proper verification and identification. Learned D.A.G submits that nothing is outstanding against the department. In the circumstances, instant petition stands disposed of being achieved its purpose.
